This leaf is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Akbutegé leaves are swallowed to restore 1–10 concussion hits. Administration is simple, but finding the plant in the semi-arid grasslands where it grows remains very difficult. No additional special effect is established in our source, so the remedy is limited to this recovery.
